Plugin.Name: LLDP for UNRAID
Plugin.Author: davidcoulson (fork of desertwitch/LLDP-unRAID)
Plugin.Overview: Integrates a Link Layer Discovery Protocol (LLDP) service (lldpd) into Unraid so the server announces itself to switches and shows its neighbors.
Plugin.Description: Integrates a Link Layer Discovery Protocol (LLDP) service (lldpd) into Unraid. LLDP lets you know exactly which switch port a server is connected to and vice versa. Supports optional CDP, FDP, SONMP and EDP.
